programme.title: Kiffin Decision Looms LARGE Ahead of PACKED Rivalry Week In CFB | Others Receiving Votes
programme.desc: Sports Illustrated's Pat Forde and Bryan Fischer are joined again by former longtime College Gameday Reporter Gene Wojciechowski for another episode of Others Receiving Votes. This week, the crew breaks down the latest in the Lane Kiffin saga as they talk about whether he should stay at Ole Miss, go to Florida or go to LSU. They also talk about what happens for the two schools that DON'T get Kiffin. Then the crew dives into a LOADED rivalry week in college football. With major College Football Playoff implications, the ORV guys talk about the massive games between Ohio State and Michigan, Texas A&M and Texas, Alabama and Auburn, Oregon and Washington and more. Following their rivalry week talk, they answer comments from Facebook Fan Groups in a segment called Commenters Commenting on Comments presented by Facebook and then give their picks for a number of Week 14 matchups in college football.
